reviews.comment: Overall, you can tell he loves what he does. However, he teaches everything if you have experience in the field. Often skips slides, mumbles, and goes on rants. Chill dude, but he made it hard to understand a lot of the course info. 3 tests and a practical, talk to the lab TAs they provide better info on the material. Good luck broski
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Honestly he's a good professor if you ask him questions but his lectures are mainly all pictures so you will not learn much if you skip class because none of his lectures have many words on them. This class is also difficult because his exam questions can be confusing.

Kovar is so funny, his lectures were a bit boring, but he would always give stories of his time spent in the field. His exams were pretty much based off lectures, attendance isn't mandatory but is helpful. It is a lot of material but he gives study guides for exams and his exams are multiple choice. I took him for 215 & 422, they were all the same.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Kovar is a great professor!! The only reason I ended with a B was because I bombed the second exam:( it's very test heavy, and the mock courtroom testimony sounds scary but it was really not bad at all. He's super nice and the lab was a ton of fun, overall a great class!
He does not do any accommodations!!

Best professor out there. I may be biased because I really enjoy Professor Kovar. Lectures are pretty monotone but he knows what he's talking about. If you ask him for more in-depth he knows everything. Best professor at Texas A&M University. Definitely use his study guides, his questions are repeated. 100% recommend.
